Readying this weapon grants 'Unburied Treasure', granting it +10 range and ?% Reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 0.5 seconds. Swords recieve ?% increased lunge distance. This benefit falls to +5 range and ?% Reduced Accuracy Cone size after #e 1 second. 

The buff continues to scale down to no noticable benefits for the remaining #e 3.5 seconds it is active. 

Enters a 3 second cooldown once the buff is removed before it can be reactivated.
